## Connecting github

```{r}
#setting to your user
use_git_config(user.name = "tintin969")
#used to check what is connected
git_sitrep()
#creates a new token to connect to github
usethis::create_github_token()
#setting which is connected with token code
gitcreds::gitcreds_set()
#checking that it worked
git_sitrep()
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
